name: AI agent with memory, a pricing tool, and a sheet tool

parameters.content:
## AI agent with memory, a pricing tool, and a sheet tool

Portfolio demo only. This workflow is an original example for demonstration. It is not client work and it does not represent a deployment for any customer.

Run **Run demo** to execute the offline rules engine. The live branch is used only when the incoming item sets `demo` to false and the placeholder credentials have been replaced.

nodes.name: Run demo
nodes.notes: CLI and the n8n editor start here. An empty manual run loads the bundled sample.

nodes.name: Inbound webhook
nodes.notes: POST JSON to this path. Include demo:false only after credentials are connected.

nodes.name: Normalize input
nodes.notes: Merges the request over the bundled sample. demo stays true unless the caller explicitly turns it off.

nodes.name: Apply rules
nodes.notes: Deterministic stand-in for the model or enrichment API. Replace or precede this with a live model node when you turn demo mode off.

nodes.name: Demo mode?
nodes.notes: True: package the offline result. False: run the credentialed apps.

options.systemMessage: You answer from tools only. If a tool does not contain the fact, say you do not know. Never invent a price.

nodes.name: AI Agent
nodes.notes: Live agent. Demo mode answers from Apply rules so tests do not spend model credits.

parameters.name: lookup_pricing
parameters.description: Look up a plan price. Input should name starter, growth, or scale.

parameters.toolDescription: Fetch a public page. Replace example.com with an API you are allowed to call.
Read the pricing sheet when the code tool is not enough.

parameters.content:
## Live path

Replace every `PLACEHOLDER_*` credential, then POST the sample with `"demo": false`.

The nodes on this branch use the `record` and `actions` fields produced by Apply rules.

meta.description: A question is answered from a local pricing book in demo mode. On the live branch an n8n AI Agent uses Groq, a short memory, a code tool for prices, an HTTP tool, and a Google Sheets tool, then posts the reply to Slack.
